Kuwait Personal Loan Calculator

Enter the amount, rate, term and net salary to see whether the loan fits the Central Bank's rules and what it really costs.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-09

Calculate your instalment

Type of finance
Status

Central Bank of Kuwait limits

  • Consumer loans: 25 times net salary, capped at KD 25,000, up to 5 years.
  • Housing finance: up to KD 70,000 over 15 years.
  • Deductions: 40% of net salary for employees, 30% for retirees.
  • Interest: discount rate + 3% at most.

Example: KD 10,000 at 5.5% reducing over 60 months on a KD 1,000 net salary.

The instalment is about KD 191 a month (19.1% of salary), within the limit. The loan complies.

These limits come from the published Central Bank instructions; banks may apply stricter terms. The rate you enter is an estimate, so ask your bank for the actual rate.

Frequently asked questions

What is the maximum consumer loan in Kuwait?

25 times net monthly salary, capped at KD 25,000, for no more than 5 years, under the Central Bank of Kuwait's consumer finance instructions.

What is the housing finance limit?

Up to KD 70,000 over a term of up to 15 years.

What debt burden is allowed?

Instalments may not exceed 40% of an employee's net salary or 30% of a retiree's.

What is the interest rate ceiling?

The rate may not exceed the Central Bank's discount rate plus 3%. The discount rate was 3.5% at the latest decision we know of (September 2026), so the ceiling is 6.5%; check for any newer decision.

Are there early repayment fees?

The instructions set no cap on processing or early settlement fees; instead, interest for the remaining term is waived on early repayment. Ask your bank for its terms.

Sources

  • Central Bank of Kuwait — consumer and housing finance instructions (2018)
